shared_elements: horizontal bands or rows of repeated signs
schematic linear figures carved/drawn in relief
justification: The most specific overlap is that both surfaces include profile birds/animal forms and rows of small repeated signs or motifs arranged in horizontal bands. The major difference is that A is dominated by isolated schematic animals and abstract motifs, while B is an organized scene of human figures beneath a radiating disc with dense text-like registers, so the iconographic schemes and relationships are largely unrelated.
